exclusions: WAFA 17:49 English publication reporting two killed including a woman near Taiba Towers is an English follow-up to the previously handed-off Arabic 16:59 report; no new distinct deaths added.
Morning Khan Younis woman injured and Jabalia four additional injuries had already been handed off in earlier watches.

Anadolu and Al Jazeera reports repeat the established storm/flooding crisis, including 70,000 flooded tents, 270 at-risk sites, 20% drainage capacity, 2,000+ collapse-risk buildings and 300,000 tents requested.
EU commissioner’s 8 November appeal concerns access advocacy rather than a verified operational change in humanitarian access.
Israeli presidential mandate for Eisenkot to form a coalition is a political development; no Gaza-specific ceasefire or negotiations change established in sources checked.
West Bank-only detention and prison health reports have no verified Gaza-specific link.
Historic Reuters/AP results, uncorroborated and recycled reports excluded.
